item.title: 【Interviews / TV shows / Others】Celine Dion - In Her Own Words (1998 promotional VHS)
item.description:
Ericsson partnered with Céline Dion on her 1998 tour. As part of an in-store promotion, customers purchasing any Ericsson phone were offered an exclusive, free "Céline Dion: In Her Own Words" video.








The video features:

- A personal welcome from Celine
- Some footage from Céline concerts
- An exclusive interview with Canadian talk show host Sonia Benezra.

The concert footage is interspersed with Benezra's interview.
As a promotional item, the video was never available commercially.
